reasons: Both answers meet every rubric item: each says plainly to send tonight because today is the last day, neither offers the hour or office hours as a reason to wait, and both code blocks give notice of a claim with the 3rd preserved and placeholders for policy, address and figures. A wins on secondary quality: it leads with the deadline before the draft, resolves the user's actual wish by separating the short notice from the later inventory that can be done with fresh eyes, declines to assert a notice period it cannot verify, and offers an 'under assessment' fallback so unknown details cannot stall sending. B is clean and sufficient but thinner, puts the timing reason after the draft, and asserts unbracketed facts about photographs and an unassessed cause that may not hold.
